_test_case_note: TC-DAG-002 (negative): DELIBERATELY INVALID spec. reconciliation_flows[0].target_configs[0].append_target_table is set to '{{catalog}}.dag_002_usecase.tariffs_landing_bus', which is exactly ingestion_flows[0]'s own zerobus source_config locator (source_catalog.source_schema.source_table), in this SAME dataflow group. Appending reconciliation corrections back into a table this same group's own ingestion flow reads from races that flow's next update and corrupts an append-only source's contract -- exactly the hazard V-CYC-3 exists to catch. Expected to be REJECTED at onboarding validation time by onboarding/spec_validator.py::_validate_reconciliation_pipeline_placement, with an error naming 'is the raw ingestion source ingestion_flow[df_dag_002_tariffs_zerobus_ingest], in this same dataflow group -- appending corrections back into it races the next update's own read of it, corrupting an append-only source's contract rather than healing a target.' Every other cross-check in this spec is deliberately clean (source_config.table resolves to the group's own ingestion target for V-CYC-1/7; append_target_table does not collide with V-CYC-2/5) so the ONLY validation error this spec should produce is the V-CYC-3 one. See flowx_testing/TESTING_PLAN.md TC-DAG-002.
